title: Holding Ctrl shows a bar on each pane with zoom and close
body:
There is no way to close a pane except from inside its client, and no zoom.

## Proposal

When Ctrl has been held alone for 300 ms, every pane's client is pushed down
one row and that row shows a bar: the pane's name on the left, `zoom` and
`x` on the right. Releasing Ctrl removes the bars. The delay keeps ordinary
chords such as Ctrl+c from moving clients. Ctrl+h, j, k, l keep working
while bars show.

Clicking `x` asks the client to close through xdg-shell; a pane with no
client is removed if transient and left as a slot if anchored. Clicking
`zoom` gives the pane the whole body and hides the rest until clicked again.

## Open

- Whether the bar should also carry the pin toggle once pins exist.
close_reason: Done in the commit titled 'Lay panes out as a split tree with anchors and a Ctrl bar', 2026-11-06, with unit tests on the layout model for bar hit areas and boundary dragging. The bar, the drag and the palette need a hand on keyboard and mouse to check and are untested on screen as of this close; Jack is the tester.
